results.name: London
results.description: If you click this, you're gonna make a lot of enemies. People hate London players because the opening is so solid and Black can do pretty much nothing to counter.

results.name: Sicilian Defense
results.description: Some people call it the Rolls Royce of openings. I call it the longest course I ever made. 38 lines - no that's not a typo. (update: now the ruy lopez is longer)

results.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted
results.description: They made the Netflix show into a real thing? Gambit a pawn, and when they take, you will win the game.

results.name: Ruy Lopez
results.description: The most solid opening on this website. If you want to win games, click here.

results.name: Vienna Gambit
results.description: Sacrifice a pawn on the third move to win a powerful position and win your pawn back three moves later.

results.name: Caro-Kann
results.description: Fight back against the King's Pawn Opening by preparing to strike back at the center.

results.name: Danish Gambit

results.name: Traxler Counterattack

results.name: Rousseau Gambit

results.description: PLEASE don't click this unless you know what you're doing.

results.description: Honestly, this one is a tough one. You won't win in 8 moves like some of the other openings. But if putting your queen out on the second move sounds interesting, this is the opening for you.

results.name: Jobava London
results.description: This is like the london but for people who actually want to have fun and make friends.

results.description: This isa one-a spicy-a meatball-a! 🍝👨‍🍳 Mamma mia!
